competitor_definition: maximum-IoU same-class candidate among those with strictly higher first-pass mapped scores; score-gap and cosine features are zero when no positive-overlap competitor exists
competitor_semantics: gap/cosine are zero unless a higher-score same-class candidate has IoU > 0

feature_semantics.competitor_cosine: zero unless an overlapping higher-score same-class candidate exists
feature_semantics.score_gap: zero unless an overlapping higher-score same-class candidate exists

selection_evidence.policy: heads fitted on Train; fixed fusion tuple and candidate selected on Val; Test used once after freezing
